create.name: Octavia Raheem
create.bio:
Octavia Raheem is a rest coach, author and teacher of restorative yoga, yoga nidra and meditation whose home community is Atlanta, Georgia. Over more than twenty years she has led classes, workshops, immersions and trainings, and once ran her own wellness studio. Her approach treats rest as a sacred practice rather than a productivity trick, and she draws on yogic methods alongside the wisdom of Black American Southern traditions. Yoga Journal included her in 2021 among fifteen yoga professionals it credited with changing the field.

She has written three books: Gather (2020), a collection of short sayings and poems; Pause, Rest, Be (2022), on stillness in times of change; and Rest Is Sacred (2024), forty brief sutras on rest as refuge, remembrance and revelation, the last two published by Shambhala. Much of her work today is with leaders and organisations. Her school, Pause, Rest, Lead, certifies rest facilitators through online courses and an in-person retreat near Atlanta, and she hosts the Devoted to Rest membership and the Leaders Devoted to Rest podcast. Each autumn she gathers members for a four-day rest summit in the North Georgia mountains, and her YouTube channel carries guided rest practices.

books.title: Rest Is Sacred: Reclaiming Our Brilliance through the Practice of Stillness
books.author: Octavia F. Raheem
books.description: Forty short sutras, with reflections and questions, that present rest as a spiritual practice. They are grouped around rest as a shelter in hard times, a way of remembering who you are, and a source of insight.

books.title: Pause, Rest, Be: Stillness Practices for Courage in Times of Change
books.author: Octavia F. Raheem
books.description: Octavia's first book with Shambhala, offering stillness and rest practices for people moving through endings, transitions and new beginnings. It opens with her own turn towards rest after years of overwork.

books.title: Gather
books.author: Octavia F. Raheem
books.description: A small book of sayings, poems and moments of insight arranged in three parts: gathering the ancestors, gathering courage and gathering rest. It is meant to be dipped into rather than read straight through.

courses.title: The Rest Summit & Retreat 2027
courses.description: Four all-inclusive days at Elohee, a retreat centre in the North Georgia mountains, led by Octavia with guest teachers. The days are built around yoga nidra, sound, ceremony, gentle movement and unhurried reflection; places are by application.

courses.title: Devoted to Rest Membership
courses.description: An application-only membership with three levels: a monthly online gathering to rest and write with an on-demand practice library, an option that adds a place at the yearly summit, and a small-group level with business coaching from Octavia and its own retreat.

courses.title: Pause, Rest, Lead Facilitator and Teacher Certification
courses.description: Octavia's school trains coaches and facilitators to bring rest practices into their own work. The path mixes required online courses with a four-day capstone retreat in or near Atlanta, and entry is by yearly application.

free_resources.title: Rest Resources
free_resources.description: A free page of recorded rest practices, including a soma nidra for deep rest and a letting-go practice, along with a rest playlist and a reading list of books on rest.
